frames.heading: Discord
frames.body: Your groove... it's powerful enough to bring order to even my chaos. Perhaps there is merit in your harmony.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Everyone has a place in the universal symphony, Discord. Now, let's place the final amp and complete our mission!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Zowie! We've saved the Universe from eternal silence! Now, let's stop the Grand Composer once and for all...
